Definition: from G1519 and G5143; to hasten inward:--run in.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to run in hastily, and it occurs once, when Rhoda hears Peter's voice at the gate. She is so glad she forgets to open the gate and runs in to tell the praying church that Peter is standing outside, and they tell her she is mad. One girl's joy runs faster than her manners, and the church's prayer is answered while they are still praying.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God answers prayer while we are still praying, because Peter was at the gate before the church had finished asking.
